scope: Displayed rally intervals, ALL original source frames including unsampled ones; no spatial clipping. Quantiles use valid final statuses; maximum Euclidean court step uses adjacent valid original frames within each rally.

far_rule.occlusion: same-frame near/far horizontal overlap >= 0.10 * far width AND near y1 < far y2; no height ratio
far_rule.depth: Nearest accepted unoccluded y2 before/after within the same fixed person and rally; linear in source frame; unlimited gap; one side held; neither missing
far_rule.x: current box centre x; project (x, depth_y_px) with unchanged tracking homography
far_rule.anchor_selection: Iterate speed filtering and accepted unoccluded depth anchors to a fixed point; anchors refer to final filter_status=observed, before smoothing
far_rule.limitation: Occluded depth is interpolation, not observation; forward/backward motion during occlusion is invisible
